cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is ACA331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, pushback and start up have been completed, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航331，从武汉飞往温哥华，已经完成了推出开车，向武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航331，完成了推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point runway 18R via A7, A, Z4, C.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，武汉地面，经由滑行道A7，A和Z4，C滑行至跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18R via A7, A, Z4, C, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A7，A，Z4和C滑行至跑道18右外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，跟随着M滑行道上的A319，滑行至跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, runway 18R is closed due to disable aircraft on the runway. Change your ATC clearance to runway 18L. ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，由于跑道上有故障航空器，18右跑道关闭。更改你的管制放行许可至18左，ZF-12D离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余不变，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, enter the runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，经由C进入18右跑道，经由C4脱离跑道，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Enter the runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, wilco, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由C进入18右跑道，经由C4脱离跑道，照办，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have vacated runway 18R via C4, report to Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在经由C4脱离跑道18右，报告给地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, we have vacated runway 18R via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航331，我们已经经由C4脱离跑道18右。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, continue taxi to holding point runway 18L via M, A, A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，继续经由滑行道M，A，A1滑行至跑道18左外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经由滑行道M，A，A1滑行至跑道18左外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800m, you see a helicopter on 10 o'clock above. It is closing to your aircraft. Inform Wuhan Departure and ask for a right turn to avoid the traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已经离地，爬升至1800米，你看到上方10点钟方向有一架直升机，它正在靠近你的飞机。报告给武汉离场，请求右转躲避航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA331, airborne, climbing to 1800m, there is a helicopter on 10 o'clock above. It is closing to our aircraft, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航331，离地了，爬升至1800米，10点钟方向有一架直升机，它正在靠近我们飞机，请求右转躲避航空器。

cards.audioText: C: ACA33I, roger, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，收到，右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [You are now at cruising level 9500m, over OBLIK, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, your squawk number is 5655.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在9500米巡航，飞过OBLIK，与郑州区调建立初始联系，你的应答机编码是5655。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, maintaining 9500m, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航331，在9500米保持，过OBLIK，应答机5655。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，郑州区调，雷达识别，上10100米保持。

cards.audioText: B: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descend for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，乘务员报告后客舱有有毒气体。你决定加速下降进行除烟程序。向郑州区调做遇险呼叫，请求在3000米平飞。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. Request expedite descend for smoke removal and level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航331，后客舱有有毒气体，请求加速下降进行除烟程序，并在3000米改平。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA331, Zhengzhou Control, roger Mayday, turn right heading 060, descend to and maintain 3000m. When able, report POB.
B: [Inform Zhengzhou Control, your POB is 223, including 5 children.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航331，郑州区调，收到Mayday，右转航向060，下降到3000米保持，可以的时候，报告机上人数。
【告知管制员，机上人数223，包括5名儿童。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 060, descend to and maintain 3000m, our POB is 223, including 5 children, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向060，下降到3000米保持，机上人数223，包括5名儿童，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, descend to 1800m and contact Zhengzhou Approach on 113.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，下降到1800米，联系郑州进近113.35。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m and contact Zhengzhou Approach on 113.35, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到1800米，联系郑州进近113.35，加航331。
